sloka: तापसानाम् अरण्यानि कांतारा गिरयः च ये ।तत्र स्थलीः मरुप्राया अति उच्च शिखराः शिलाः ॥४-४२-९॥
transliteration: tāpasānām araṇyāni kāṁtārā girayaḥ ca ye ।tatra sthalīḥ maruprāyā ati ucca śikharāḥ śilāḥ ॥4-42-9॥

translations.english: 'O monkeys the auspicious rivers with cool waters flow towards the western region. Search in the groves inhabited by ascetics, other forests, mountains, cliffs, in the desertland. Search in the inaccessible western region surrounded by mountains. Then proceed to the western ocean infested with whales and alligators, which cannot be easily disturbed.
